<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection circuit for the sequence '10011' using a Mealy FSM.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Single-bit input signal.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>STATE_IDLE</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE_1</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE_2</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE_3</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE_4</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE_MATCH</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width="3">Current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <wire id="next_state" width="3">Next state of the FSM.</wire>
        <wire id="match_condition">Match condition detected.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge CLK or negedge RST) begin
            if (!RST) begin
                current_state <= STATE_IDLE;
                MATCH <= 0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
                MATCH <= match_condition;
            end
        end

        // Next state determination
        always @(*) begin
            case (current_state)
                STATE_IDLE: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = STATE_1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_IDLE;
                    end
                end
                STATE_1: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = STATE_2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_IDLE;
                    end
                end
                STATE_2: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = STATE_3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_IDLE;
                    end
                end
                STATE_3: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = STATE_4;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_IDLE;
                    end
                end
                STATE_4: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = STATE_MATCH;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_IDLE;
                    end
                end
                STATE_MATCH: begin
                    next_state = STATE_IDLE;
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = STATE_IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end

        // Match condition logic
        always @(*) begin
            match_condition = (current_state == STATE_MATCH);
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
